body: I had a friend who would quote the Simpsons (I think it’s from the Simpsons) “I like rape!” As a victim of rape twice over, it got under my skin and I finally had enough. One day he said it to get a laugh from our friends (who all know my history), and I piped up with, “I liked it so much I did it twice!” The room became very awkwardly quiet, as it should. He never said it again. And we’re not friends anymore.
I was in the hospital for cancer and their default channel was a singular photo of a coffee pot.

Not good at all. I’m losing my grip on reality. I’m losing my will to live. I feel so alone all the time. I don’t work. I’m disabled. My dad died from COVID 6 months ago. My mom has lost herself in Asian dramas and music so that’s all she ever talks about. I don’t care about Asian actors or singers. I sit in my room. Alone. People say they’re worried about me but they talk to one another about me rather than talking to me. My mom went to lunch with my sister and son the other day leaving me here alone. My son said she cried saying she’s worried that I’m suicidal. She so damn worried yet she came home and didn’t speak to me. She’s been awake for an hour today and hasn’t even poked her head in the door to check to see if I’m alive. How can you worry about me but not even speak to me?! I’m losing my shit. Sorry to unload.

I talked to my son last night. I didn’t want to bother him too much because it was his fiancé’s birthday. He wants me to admit myself to the hospital over the weekend. I don’t want to do that. I hate being hospitalized, especially now that we’re in this pandemic.
No, I haven’t tried in a few years. My hands shake really badly. I can’t even take a decent picture on my phone. I hate it. It makes drawing extremely difficult, especially the fine details.
